_about: Quote card lines. Attribution checked; see the comment above LINES in the app for quotes deliberately left out as misattributed.

quotes.text: The last three or four reps is what makes the muscle grow. This area of pain divides the champion from someone who is not a champion.
The mind is the limit. As long as the mind can envision the fact that you can do something, you can do it.
Strength does not come from winning. Your struggles develop your strengths.
Everybody wanna be a bodybuilder, but don't nobody wanna lift no heavy-ass weights.
Exercise is king. Nutrition is queen. Put them together and you've got a kingdom.
The only way you can hurt the body is not use it.
I hated every minute of training, but I said, don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
I don't count my sit-ups. I only start counting when it starts hurting.
It isn't the mountains ahead to climb that wear you out; it's the pebble in your shoe.
I fear not the man who has practiced 10,000 kicks once, but I fear the man who has practiced one kick 10,000 times.
If you always put limits on everything you do, physical or anything else, it will spread into your work and into your life.
Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
You are in danger of living a life so comfortable and soft that you will die without ever realizing your true potential.
Discipline is doing what you hate to do, but doing it like you love it.
Discipline equals freedom.
The disciplined ones in life are free. It's the undisciplined ones who are in prison.
We must all suffer one of two things: the pain of discipline or the pain of regret.
Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Keep the faculty of effort alive in you by a little gratuitous exercise every day.
quotes.by: William James, The Principles of Psychology

quotes.text: Enthusiasm is common. Endurance is rare.
Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms, to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
quotes.by: Viktor Frankl, Man's Search for Meaning

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself: I have to go to work, as a human being.
No great thing is created suddenly.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.by: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
